info.title: Smart Inventory API
info.description: REST API for the AI-Driven Smart Inventory Management and Automated Receipt Digitization System. Amounts are in Kenyan Shillings (KES).

post.description: Sign in with username (or email) and password.
Exchange the refresh cookie for a new access token (and a rotated cookie).
Change your own password. Other devices are signed out.
Set a new password using a one-time link issued by an administrator.

get.description: Devices currently signed in to your account.

schema.title: Response My Sessions Api V1 Auth Sessions Get

delete.description: Sign out one of your other devices.

post.description: Register a staff member. Omit `password` to get a one-time setup link instead.
Issue a one-time password reset link to give to the staff member.
Sign the user out of every device.

schema.title: Response List Roles Api V1 Roles Get

get.description: Newest first. Dates are interpreted in the store's timezone (Africa/Nairobi).

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Categories Get

get.description: Search by name (typo-tolerant), SKU or barcode; filter by category and stock state.

schema.title: Response List Products Api V1 Products Get
Response Create Product Api V1 Products Post

get.description: Find the product for a scanned barcode or typed SKU (exact match).

schema.title: Response Get Product Api V1 Products  Product Id  Get
Response Update Product Api V1 Products  Product Id  Patch

delete.description: Permanently delete a product that has never had stock. Otherwise deactivate it.

post.description: Give a product without a manufacturer barcode an internal EAN-13 (prefix 20).

schema.title: Response Generate Barcode Api V1 Products  Product Id  Barcode Post
Response Upload Image Api V1 Products  Product Id  Image Post
Response Delete Image Api V1 Products  Product Id  Image Delete
Response Product Batches Api V1 Products  Product Id  Batches Get

get.description: Suppliers of this product with their last prices (cheapest first).

schema.title: Response Product Suppliers Api V1 Products  Product Id  Suppliers Get
Response Supplier Products Api V1 Suppliers  Supplier Id  Products Get

put.description: Record that this supplier sells the product (and their code / last price).

get.description: The stock ledger, newest first. `movement_type` accepts a comma-separated list.

post.description: Record a stock count or correction. Large changes wait for manager approval.
Remove damaged or expired goods from stock (FEFO unless a batch is chosen).

get.description: Store details printed on receipts, and the cashier discount limit.

post.description:
Complete a sale: prices come from the catalogue; stock is deducted atomically.

Re-sending the same `client_request_id` returns the original sale (status 200).

get.description: Cashiers see only their own sales.
Totals by payment method, e.g. for the end-of-day cash-up.

post.description: Return items from a receipt. Cashiers' returns wait for a manager's approval.
Mark the order as sent to the supplier (by phone, email or in person).
Record goods received: stock, average cost, batches and supplier prices update.

schema.title: Response Expense Categories Api V1 Expense Categories Get
Response Analytics Products Api V1 Analytics Products Get

get.description: Everything the profit page needs in one request.

post.description: Upload a supplier invoice. It is read in the background; poll until NEEDS_REVIEW.

get.description: Counts by status and how often reviewers had to correct the OCR (real accuracy).

put.description: Save the reviewer's corrections. Stock is not changed until approval.

post.description: Receive the reviewed invoice into stock (creates a goods-received note).
Read the document again (e.g. after adding the supplier or products).

get.description:
Defaults to the last 30 days. Sales and stock value need finance permission;
irregularities need anomaly permission.
The latest forecast for every product, most urgent (earliest stock-out) first.

post.description: Re-train and re-forecast in the background (takes a few seconds to a minute).

get.description: Actual sales for the last 13 weeks and the forecast with its 80% interval.
What to order now, grouped by each product's usual supplier.

schema.title: Response Reorder Api V1 Forecasts Reorder Get

get.description: Open alerts by severity and the real-world precision of reviewed alerts.

post.description: Record what the investigation found. Resolving needs a note.

schema.title: Response Unread Count Api V1 Notifications Unread Count Get

post.description: Mark the given notifications (or, with no ids, all of them) as read.

schema.title: Response Mark Read Api V1 Notifications Read Post

get.description: The reports this user may download.

schema.title: Response Report Types Api V1 Reports Get
Response List Backups Api V1 System Backups Get

AdjustmentCreate.title: AdjustmentCreate
AdjustmentCreate.description: Either a physical count (`counted_quantity`) or a direct change (`quantity_change`).

file.title: File
file.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 5 MB

client_request_id.title: Client Request Id
client_request_id.description: Random id generated by the till; resubmitting it returns the same sale

ProductOut.title: ProductOut
ProductOut.description: Product as seen by everyone with products:read (no cost data).

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description:
Partial update. Stock quantity and average cost are NOT editable here: they change
only through stock movements, so the ledger stays the single source of truth.

ProductWithCost.title: ProductWithCost
ProductWithCost.description: Adds cost and margin for roles with products:view_cost.

password.title: Password
password.description: Initial password. If omitted, a one-time setup link is returned instead.
